59/G.goal: Explain the resource optimization logic of the Majuli VR case study, from the demands of multimodal real-time rendering to platform-specific choices for Oculus Quest 2 and smartphone/cardboard deployment.
59/G.achieves: It gives the learner a concrete foundation for the course's system optimization and resource-requirements topics by linking hardware constraints, rendering demands, and deployment decisions in a practical VR system.

59/O1.goal: Explain the resource optimization logic of the Majuli VR case study, showing why its multimodal content demands optimization and how its Oculus Quest 2 and smartphone/cardboard deployments balance local resources, network use, and content fidelity.
59/O1.achieves: It lets the learner evaluate storage, computation, network, and content-quality trade-offs when deploying VR applications on constrained or standalone devices, supporting the course aim of implementing XR systems with confidence.
